name: fewkit
description: Fewkit: the lean Claude Code bundle. CodeKickoff on day one, Fewturns every day after, Wavecheck before a release, Fullburn against a deadline.

plugins.name: codekickoff
plugins.description: First setup for Claude Code newcomers, sized to your plan. One skill, no hooks, nothing collected.

plugins.name: fewturns
plugins.description: Trims what every Claude Code request carries and the requests a task takes. One skill, no hooks, nothing collected.

plugins.name: wavecheck
plugins.description: A deep check in waves before a release: read-only helpers, a critic after each wave, two verifiers per lead. Spends requests on purpose; lite for smaller plans. One skill, no hooks, nothing collected.

plugins.name: fullburn
plugins.description: A swarm against a deadline: many helper agents at once, each in its own git worktree, merged and checked in waves, with a usage watch. Spends usage very fast, on purpose; Pro runs it lite. Two skills, no hooks, nothing collected.
